wargear.name: Horsetail standard
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A tall pole hung with the manes of a hundred fallen rivals, which the unit follows as a banner and a challenge. Every model in the unit gains +1 Movement.

wargear.name: Stormcaller's totem
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A bone and feather fetish, empty of any power until a Stormseer decides otherwise. The model gains +1 Willpower and +1 Cool.

option.text: The Sergeant may take a Chogorian war-sabre

The Sergeant may exchange their chainsword for

The unit may carry a Horsetail standard

modifiers.text: Born to the saddle: +1 I, -1 LD.
Sworn to the Khan: +1 WS, -1 BS.
Voice of the storm: +1 IN, -1 CL.

rules.name: Storm Riders
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Great Hunt). Riders who burst out of the flank are already committed. A unit with this rule that enters play from Reserves may declare a Charge on the turn it arrives.

rules.name: Khagan's Escort
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Khagan's Own). The Khan's chosen ride where he rides. While within 12" of the Khan, Qin Xa or Hibou Khan, a unit with this rule may re-roll failed Cool Checks and adds +1 to its Charge rolls.

rules.name: Tempest-Born
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Calling the Tempest). Wind, dust and lightning gather round the Stormseers' brothers. A unit with this rule gains Shrouded (6+) against Shooting Attacks.

rules.name: Killers in the Dark
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Dark Sons Descend). The Dark Sons are in place before the enemy knows a fight has begun. A unit with this rule gains Infiltrate (9). On the first battle turn, enemy units may not make Reaction Shooting against it.

rites.name: The Great Hunt
rites.flavor: The steppe has no fortresses. It has only prey that has not yet noticed it is being run down.
benefits: Outrider Squadrons, Scimitar Jetbike Squadrons and Golden Keshig may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Those units gain Storm Riders: Outflank, and a unit entering from Reserves may still Charge that turn.
limitations: At least two Outrider, Scimitar or Keshig units are required.
At least one unit with Storm Riders must start the battle in Reserves.
No Terminator squads, and no Armour, Heavy Transport or War Engine units.

modifiers.text: The Great Hunt: Line (1), Storm Riders, Outflank.

require.note: Bring at least two cavalry squads.

rites.name: The Khagan's Own
rites.flavor: When the Khan's own riders and shadows take the line, the rest of the Legion simply follows.
benefits: Golden Keshig and Ebon Keshig may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Keshig gain Khagan's Escort: while within 12" of the Khan, Qin Xa or Hibou Khan they may re-roll failed Cool Checks and add +1 to Charge rolls.
limitations: The Khan, Qin Xa or Hibou Khan must lead the army.
At least two Keshig units are required.
No Tactical, Despoiler, Breacher, Scout or Inductii Squads.

modifiers.text: The Khagan's Own: Line (1), Khagan's Escort.

require.note: The Khan, Qin Xa or Hibou Khan must lead the army.
Bring at least two Keshig units.

rites.name: Calling the Tempest
rites.flavor: The Stormseers raise their voices, and the sky answers in kind.
benefits: Falcon's Claws may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Stormseers and Falcon's Claws gain Tempest-Born: Shrouded (6+) against Shooting Attacks.
limitations: At least two Stormseers are required.
No Armour, Heavy Transport or Lord of War units.

rites.name: Dark Sons Descend
rites.flavor: No one remembers the Dark Sons' names. They like it that way, and so does the Khan.
benefits: Dark Sons of Death may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Dark Sons gain Killers in the Dark: Infiltrate (9), and enemy units may not make Reaction Shooting against them on the first battle turn.
limitations: At least two Dark Sons of Death squads are required.
No Stormseers or other models with the Psyker Trait.

modifiers.text: Dark Sons Descend: Line (1), Killers in the Dark, Infiltrate (9).

require.note: Bring at least two Dark Sons of Death squads.
